prompts.reply: Hello there, human. Nice to see you.
I am a browser chatbot. Weather? It's probably cold. Because Ohio.
I only know what you've trained me with. Edit data/prompts.json to teach me more.
I cannot feel emotions, but I can pretend. I am 100 percent operational.
You cannot escape me. Just kidding. Close the browser tab.
